Marta: Quick presales note  buyer requires primary processing in Frankfurt (eu-central-1) with deterministic failover to Montreal (ca-central-1). Control plane must NOT transit US. BYOK (customer HSM) mandatory. Any immediate blockers?
Liam: Hosted control plane is US by default. For POC recommend Private control plane in customer VPC (fast) or Dedicated with regional control-plane (contract change) for prod.
Liam: We can tenant-pin dataplane to eu-central-1 and failover to ca-central-1. Need telemetry disabled to meet locality guarantee.
Aisha: We'll produce subprocessor register (cloud providers + infra partners). Note: AWS staff operate in DE, GCP staff in CA; if pinned properly no third-country subprocessors should touch tenant data.
Omar: Pricing impact: POC (30d) = setup fee + small reserved capacity + egress buffer for DE<->CA failover tests. Prod = Private/Dedicated monthly commit + BYOK integration fee + optional SLA uplift. Include egress estimates for replication during DR.
Aisha: Setup estimate 30-45 eng hours for Private deploy + peering + KMS integration. POC timeline ~10 business days if network contacts provided.
InfraBot: Ticket GEO-POC-900 created: "DE primary / CA failover / customer BYOK" assigned to Liam.
Marta: I'll draft SOW language: "control plane deployed in customer VPC; telemetry exports disabled; subprocessor register attached" and share with buyer. Scheduling ops sync for tomorrow.
